name: Incentives credit against cost ex-land
description:
A deal that fails the land test at full cost and clears it once a public incentive is credited. Hand-computed from the First Look formulas rather than transcribed from the workbook, because the workbook has no incentives row — this is the app extending it, so the arithmetic is written out here for a reader to check without running the engine.

Supported cost = 3,000,000/0.075 + 1,000,000/0.075 + 6,500,000/0.065 = 40,000,000 + 13,333,333.333333334 + 100,000,000 = 153,333,333.33333334.
Cost ex-land 160,000,000 less incentives 25,000,000 = net cost 135,000,000.
Land before carry = 153,333,333.33333334 - 135,000,000 = 18,333,333.333333343.
Max land = that / 1.055 = 17,377,567.140600327.
Ask 15,000,000, so the land test passes with headroom 2,377,567.1406003274.
YoC on cost = 10,500,000 / 135,000,000 = 0.07777777777777778, against a blended hurdle of 10,500,000 / 153,333,333.33333334 = 0.06847826086956521. At full cost the same deal yields 6.5625% and max land is only -6,318,957.345971563, which is why the ask fails without the credit.
source: Hand-computed. Incentives are an app addition; see docs/build-spec-v2.md B5 §4.
